messages:
morgan: Heads-up — customer acme-inc seeing intermittent failures when streaming /v1/chat/stream: payloads cut off mid-response, client sees ECONNRESET and 502s. Started ~45m ago and still happening. sample trace id: trace-7f1a2b3c

sasha: thanks. any repro steps or curl? which region?

morgan: repro with chunked streaming. region us-west-2. curl example:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"stream test"}],"stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream
```
It cuts after first few tokens, client gets HTTP/2 RST_STREAM from Envoy.

eng-sre-bot: alert: hostedapi-gw-upstream-reset rate increased 7x in us-west-2 over last 20m

ira: can you paste the envoy log lines for the failing request ids? also check if any midstream reconfigs (tls rotate, routing) happened.

morgan: envoy logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-16T14:03:12Z] [trace-7f1a2b3c] envoy upstream reset: connection reset by peer, response incomplete
[2026-03-16T14:03:12Z] [trace-7f1a2b3c] downstream response: 502
```
Also saw repeated 504s when payloads >64KB.

sasha: noticed a spike in fanout latency to model-pool-3 around same time, queue depth up and some backpressure logs: `request buffer overflow`

julia-support: customer impact: many requests timed out in app -> user-visible errors. I told them we're investigating and asked for request IDs; they provided two more: trace-83a2, trace-9b7f.

ira: quick mitigation — increase stream idle timeout on the route to 90s and enable per-request retry=0 to avoid early replay. rolling deploy in 5m?

morgan: OK will patch route defaults. also: suspect an upstream model replica had OOM/slow start leading to abrupt conn closes.

runtime-oncall: I'm pulling model-host logs for pool-3, looking for OOMs. If confirmed, we'll drain affected replica and spin up fresh one.

julia-support: customer update ready: "We've routed around an unhealthy downstream replica; retries disabled; please let us know if you see further errors." :thumbsup:

morgan: filing support ticket and will follow up with full postmortem if root cause is replica OOM. Thanks everyone.
